description: Defines the ClientConfig interface for connectivity client settings, including timeout and retry configurations, with an inner enum for default config values.

classes.name: ClientConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for connectivity client settings.

classes.name: ClientConfig.ClientConfigValue
classes.description: Enum implementing KnownConfigValue, providing default configuration values and paths for ClientConfig.

methods.name: getConnectingMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the initial minimum timeout when connecting to a remote system.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for reconnecting to a remote system.

methods.name: getSubscriptionManagerTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for SubscriptionManager to wait for search commands.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration after failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration after failure.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retries for connecting to a remote system.

methods.name: getTestingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for testing a new connection.
